name: item
useFor: Use for rows in a list that are not a table: results (a site's image, name and DM Mono coordinates, Fog tags at the end), the sources behind an answer, or rail rows (size sm). Render a link or button with asChild so the row fills on hover; mark the current one with aria-current. Rule rows with ItemSeparator. Use outline for a standalone row, muted inside a Bone panel.
constraints: Hover fills on rows that do nothing
More than two tags per row
source: LAND data-table (the Leads sites list) and Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433): Sources
title: Item
description: A row of content: a site with its aerial, name, coordinates and tags; a source; a rail row. Square, Fog under the pointer, Mist when current.
